posts.author: LarsInvest
posts.text: Nå er EANM endelig i gang i Wien. Jasper Kurth (CEO i Thor Medical) har delt dette innlegget fra Thijs Spoor (CEO i Perspective Therapeutics)->  It was great to join colleagues at #EANM2026 in Vienna for a Comecer-supported symposium exploring the merits of different #theranostic isotopes. A productive discussion and an opportunity to share why we’re so excited about the potential of lead-212.  At Perspective Therapeutics, we’ve made significant investments across the #radiopharmaceutical value chain, and we’re proud to have brought investigational therapies to more than 150 patients around the world. With Phase 3 preparations underway for VMT-α-NET, continued engagement with regulators, and ongoing development of VMT01 and PSV359, there’s a lot to look forward to.  We’re just getting started! Thanks to European Association of Nuclear Medicine (EANM) for the invitation. https://www.linkedin.com/posts/thijs-spoor-biotech_eanm2026-theranostic-radiopharmaceutical-share-7517243547503267840-0BaU/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_ios&rcm=ACoAADUVyGgBbKFcdpxXInSkiOE2XLD9nnPl2WY

posts.text: Hvis jeg hadde hatt 400K aksjer her inne, med GAV  på eksempelvis emipris 4.,8 Nok..hvilken strategi ville jeg gått for hvis jeg vurderer at pengene mine må ut nå -med minst mulig tap? Fint om svarene (hvis det kommer noen) kan forankres i reell kompetanse på området 👍 FYI: Dette er helt hypotetisk fra min side, men jeg er oppriktig interessert i om jeg ville hatt noe påvirkningskraft på kursen hvis jeg satt med 400K aksjer i TM
